criteria.text: A cloud token that does not exist in local sessions is accepted and req.auth.user.id resolves to the correct local user by googleSub, with the local-session absence precondition asserted.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c1: accepts a Cloud-only bearer and writes the Google-subject-matched local owner

criteria.text: At least twenty subsequent agent requests with the same valid bearer make exactly one Cloud /auth/me request within five minutes.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c2: one positive Cloud verification covers at least twenty desktop fan-out requests

criteria.text: Positive Cloud authentication cache entries expire after five minutes.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c3: a positive cache entry expires after five minutes

criteria.text: The positive Cloud authentication cache is bounded and evicts its oldest entry when full.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c4: the positive cache evicts its oldest entry at its bound

criteria.text: An invalid Cloud token returns 401 and negative authentication results are never cached.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c5: invalid Cloud tokens fail 401 and are never cached

criteria.text: An unreachable Cloud identity service propagates 503 AUTH_UNAVAILABLE, never 200, and the failure is not cached.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c6: unreachable Cloud fails 503 AUTH_UNAVAILABLE and is never cached

criteria.text: A token whose Cloud identity maps to a different local user cannot read the first user's agent session.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c7: a different Cloud-mapped user cannot read the owner session

criteria.text: The Cloud base URL comes only from RHYTHM_CLOUD_API_URL, PROD_API_URL, or the shipped default and cannot be overridden by request input.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c8: Cloud verification URL comes from env, not request input

criteria.text: Captured server log output contains neither the bearer token nor a distinctive substring from it.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c9: authentication logs contain no bearer or distinctive token fragment

criteria.text: The absent-Authorization AGENT_LOCAL bypass remains exactly as-is and does not invoke Cloud authentication.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c10: absent Authorization keeps the existing AGENT_LOCAL bypass

criteria.text: An env-gated live test drives the Flutter desktop's list, create, detail, todo, memory-provenance, VCS, VCS status, and agents sequence through the real isolated API and engine.
criteria.test_id: local-agent-cloud-token-auth-c11: Cloud-only bearer drives list, create, detail, todo, provenance, and VCS through the real API
